text.id: HP Sekar geter di bawah bantal. Gue ketiduran di sofa lagi. Langit di jendela masih item.
text.en: Sekar's phone buzzes under my pillow. I fell asleep on the sofa again. The sky in the window is still black.

text.id: Dermaga kayu, langit oranye, laut yang masih abu-abu. Kapal biru-putih diiket di ujungnya. Persis wallpaper HP Sekar.
text.en: A wooden jetty, an orange sky, a sea still grey. A blue and white boat tied at the end. Exactly like the wallpaper on Sekar's phone.

text.id: Bedanya, di pinggir foto ini ada bakau. Muara Angke nggak punya bakau lagi dari sebelum gue lahir.
text.en: Except at the edge of this photo there are mangroves. Muara Angke hasn't had mangroves since before I was born.

text.id: Dibaca. Nggak dibales. Kali ini, buat pertama kalinya, "dibaca" kerasa kayak jawaban.
text.en: Read. No reply. This time, for the first time, "read" feels like an answer.

text.id: Gue simpen fotonya dan nggak ngetik apa-apa. Kalau dia di sana, dia tahu gue nerima. Kalau bukan dia, gue nggak ngasih apa-apa.
text.en: I save the photo and don't type anything. If it's her, she knows I got it. If it isn't, I've given them nothing.
